notes: The input is the text of one component.yaml. context.subject is the label that the entry point takes as its second argument.
params.site is the site file of the vector. For `set`, the site file holds the account and the home of context.operator. For `missing`, the host has no site file.
value is the parsed manifest. A path that starts with `~/` holds the home of the operator in place of `~`.
refusal holds the check, the subject and the detail of the refusal, as the ledger holds them. The subject of a nested mapping ends with `: ` and the field.
A detail of the form `does not parse: line N` gives the line of the mark of PyYAML, from 1.
A refusal with the check `site` names the site file. Its detail holds <site> in place of the path of that file.
The vectors with the id `repo-<directory>` hold each component.yaml of this repository.

path: attendance
kind: venv
unit: creche-attendance.service
runs_as: operator
build:
  - ["/usr/local/bin/uv", "sync", "--frozen", "--no-editable", "--package", "attendance"]
install:
  to: ~/.local/components/attendance
  prev: ~/.local/components/attendance.prev
provides:
  - { contract: session-api, major: 1, minor: 4 }
requires:
  - { contract: channel, major: 1, min_minor: 3 }
  - { contract: pep-grant, major: 2, min_minor: 0 }
depends_on: !!seq chaperone
verify:
  command: ["~/.local/components/attendance/bin/attendance-verify", "--json"]
  user: operator
  timeout_s: 60
restore:
  mode: automatic
  keep: 1
secrets: [session_key]
release: yes

# The session service, and the four front doors that ship with it.
# Contract 06 §1 row 2, and §1 rule 1: a door cannot be at a different
# version from the session API it serves, so it is not its own component.
manifest_version: "0.4"
name: attendance
repo: agent-control
path: attendance
kind: venv
# `creche-attendance.service`, like every other user unit on the rework plane.
# Step 9 restarts the unit this NAMES; a name no installed unit answers to
# is listed under `manual` and silently never restarted (§1 rule 7).
unit: creche-attendance.service
runs_as: operator
# All four packages, because `attendance` depends on none of the doors
# and three units run from this one tree. `--package` repeats: measured
# against uv 0.12.17 on 2026-09-20, one sync fills one environment with all
# four. `agent-door-tui` is here too — `agent-tui` is a command the operator runs,
# from the same tree, at the same version as the API it speaks to.
# `--no-editable`: contract 06 §8.2. Three units run from this one tree, so
# without it a deploy changes what all three load at their next restart.
build:
  - ["/usr/local/bin/uv", "sync", "--frozen", "--no-editable",
     "--package", "attendance",
     "--package", "agent-door-owui",
     "--package", "agent-door-tui",
     "--package", "agent-door-trigger"]
install:
  to: ~/.local/components/attendance
  prev: ~/.local/components/attendance.prev
provides:
  # Contract 02: create, list, run turn, attach, stop, the journal, events.
  - { contract: session-api, major: 0, minor: 12 }
requires:
  # Contract 03's host side: one channel per sandbox, over sbx exec stdio.
  - { contract: channel, major: 0, min_minor: 12 }
  # Contract 04 §7.3: it serves the PEP's one session path.
  - { contract: pep-grant, major: 0, min_minor: 11 }
  # Contract 05: it reads caregiver's status document and writes a fault file.
  - { contract: manager-status, major: 0, min_minor: 16 }
depends_on: [chaperone, playpen]
verify:
  # --env-file: the same file
  # systemd/creche-attendance.service's own EnvironmentFile= names, read by
  # the hook itself as the operator. Pinned equal by
  # handover/tests/test_handover_r7r_verify_env.py.
  command: ["~/.local/components/attendance/bin/attendance-verify", "--json",
            "--env-file", "/srv/agents/state/rework/sessiond.env"]
  user: operator
  timeout_s: 60
restore:
  mode: automatic
  keep: 3
secrets: []
release: yes

# The family manager: the reconciler that converges every family to its
# family.yaml. Contract 06 §1 row 3.
manifest_version: "0.4"
name: caregiver
repo: agent-control
path: caregiver
kind: venv
unit: creche-caregiver.service
runs_as: operator
# `--no-editable` is what makes the installed tree self-contained (contract
# 06 §8.2). Without it `uv sync` writes `_editable_impl_caregiver.pth`
# and `_editable_impl_agent_family.pth` into the tree, and the reconciler
# imports every first-party module from `/opt/creche/*/src` instead.
build:
  - ["/usr/local/bin/uv", "sync", "--frozen", "--no-editable",
     "--package", "caregiver"]
install:
  to: ~/.local/components/caregiver
  prev: ~/.local/components/caregiver.prev
provides:
  # Contract 01: the family.yaml and mcp/<name>/server.yaml schemas.
  - { contract: family-file, major: 0, minor: 13 }
  # Contract 05: per-family status, sandbox state, switch-sandbox.
  - { contract: manager-status, major: 0, minor: 16 }
requires:
  # Contract 04: it writes the PEP's grant file and mints the family token.
  - { contract: pep-grant, major: 0, min_minor: 11 }
  # Contract 03: supervisor.env carries the mount paths the channel fixes.
  - { contract: channel, major: 0, min_minor: 12 }
  # Contract 02: it asks attendance to drain a session before a replacement.
  - { contract: session-api, major: 0, min_minor: 12 }
depends_on: [chaperone, infra]
verify:
  # --env-file: root's executor hands the hook none of the unit's
  # environment (contract 06 §4 rule 7). The same file
  # systemd/creche-caregiver.service's own EnvironmentFile= names, read by
  # the hook itself as the operator. Pinned equal by
  # handover/tests/test_handover_r7r_verify_env.py.
  command: ["~/.local/components/caregiver/bin/caregiver-verify", "--json",
            "--env-file", "/srv/agents/state/rework/managerd.env"]
  user: operator
  timeout_s: 60
restore:
  mode: automatic
  keep: 3
secrets: []
release: yes

# The Policy Enforcement Point. Contract 06 §1 row 1.
#
# The one hardened system unit. It holds every upstream credential, so it is
# the component whose restart window matters most: a release swaps the tree
# and restarts the unit, and every in-flight tool call is dropped.
manifest_version: "0.4"
name: chaperone
repo: agent-control
path: chaperone
kind: venv
unit: creche-chaperone.service
runs_as: root
# `--no-editable`: contract 06 §8.2. This is the one unit that runs as its
# own hardened user, so a tree reading its code out of `/opt/creche/
# */src` would put every upstream credential behind a deploy rather than
# behind a release.
build:
  - ["/usr/local/bin/uv", "sync", "--frozen", "--no-editable",
     "--package", "chaperone"]
install:
  to: /opt/components/chaperone
  prev: /opt/components/chaperone.prev
provides:
  # Contract 04, the per-family grant file, the family token and audit v2.
  - { contract: pep-grant, major: 0, minor: 11 }
requires:
  # `delegate.py` calls attendance to start a thin job's turn (contract 02 §3).
  - { contract: session-api, major: 0, min_minor: 12 }
depends_on: []
verify:
  command: ["/opt/components/chaperone/bin/chaperone-verify", "--json", "--env-file", "/etc/creche/site.env"]
  user: root
  timeout_s: 60
restore:
  mode: automatic
  keep: 3
secrets: []
release: yes

# The release tool itself. Contract 06 §1 row 8, and §1.1 for how it ships
# without replacing the code under its own running process: the resolver
# forces it last in `order`, its switch happens after the ledger is written
# and the lock is released, and its verify hook then runs as a fresh process
# out of the new tree. A failed hook puts the previous tree back.
#
# The path unit (creche-handover.path) and the root wrapper at
# /usr/local/sbin/creche-handover stay outside every release. The thing
# that deploys code is not deployed by code.
#
# `unit: null`, and it is the only answer this component can have. Step 9
# refreshes a unit file in place, restarts the unit, then polls `is-active`
# and `NRestarts` for twenty seconds. creche-handover.service is a
# path-activated ONESHOT: restarting it re-enters the drain that is running
# the release, and `is-active` on a oneshot that has exited is `inactive`, so
# the poll would fail every handover release. The switch happens after the
# ledger is written and the lock released (§1.1), and the hook below runs
# right after it, as a child of the executor that swapped.
manifest_version: "0.4"
name: handover
repo: agent-control
path: handover
kind: venv
unit: null
runs_as: root
# `--no-editable`: contract 06 §8.2. This one matters twice over — the tree
# holds the executor that performs every other release, so a tree reading its
# own code out of a repository checkout would let a deploy change the release
# tool with no release.
build:
  - ["/usr/local/bin/uv", "sync", "--frozen", "--no-editable",
     "--package", "handover"]
install:
  to: /opt/components/handover
  prev: /opt/components/handover.prev
provides:
  # Contract 06: the manifest shape, the resolver and the allocator.
  - { contract: component-manifest, major: 0, minor: 18 }
requires: []
depends_on: []
verify:
  # What it proves is what a venv release can break — that the renamed tree's
  # console script still starts (`uv venv --relocatable`). `--root` names the
  # tree itself, which holds no `component.yaml`: the hook inherits the
  # executor's working directory, and a `check` with no root once read a
  # manifest there and refused it (2026-09-24). `--partial`, because the tree
  # holds none of contract 06 §1's components.
  #
  # `--site` reads every value the executor needs from the site file. A new
  # executor that cannot start on this host's file fails here, while the old
  # one is still there to be put back.
  command: ["/opt/components/handover/bin/handover", "check", "--partial",
            "--json", "--site", "--root", "/opt/components/handover"]
  user: root
  timeout_s: 60
restore:
  mode: automatic
  keep: 3
secrets: []
release: yes

# The noticeboard. Contract 06 §1 row 4, and §1 rule 7 for the unit name: this
# component owns `creche-noticeboard.service`, the user unit that runs it on
# the host.
manifest_version: "0.4"
name: noticeboard
repo: agent-control
path: noticeboard
kind: venv
unit: creche-noticeboard.service
runs_as: operator
# `--no-editable`: contract 06 §8.2. The templates and the stylesheet under
# `src/noticeboard/` are read through `Path(__file__).parent`, and hatchling
# packages both directories, so a non-editable tree carries them.
build:
  - ["/usr/local/bin/uv", "sync", "--frozen", "--no-editable",
     "--package", "noticeboard"]
install:
  to: ~/.local/components/noticeboard
  prev: ~/.local/components/noticeboard.prev
provides: []
requires:
  # Contract 02: it reads sessions, turns and the event stream.
  - { contract: session-api, major: 0, min_minor: 12 }
  # Contract 05: it reads the per-family status document.
  - { contract: manager-status, major: 0, min_minor: 16 }
  # Contract 04: it reads the audit record and the grant a family holds.
  - { contract: pep-grant, major: 0, min_minor: 11 }
depends_on: [attendance, caregiver]
verify:
  # --env-file: the same file
  # systemd/creche-noticeboard.service's own EnvironmentFile= names, read by the
  # hook itself as the operator. Pinned equal by
  # handover/tests/test_handover_r7r_verify_env.py.
  command: ["~/.local/components/noticeboard/bin/noticeboard-verify", "--json",
            "--env-file", "/srv/agents/state/rework/view.env"]
  user: operator
  timeout_s: 60
restore:
  mode: automatic
  keep: 3
secrets: []
release: yes

# The image every family's microVM runs: pi, the playpen and the PEP
# bridge. Contract 06 §1 row 5. One release replaces every family's sandbox
# (§1 rule 5), so a component has one live version and the manifest carries
# no range (§2.2).
#
# `build` runs `bin/playpen-build` out of the fetched source. It builds the
# two images, pushes them to the host's own registry, and writes the tree a
# release swaps in: `images.env`, one digest per flavor, and the verify hook.
# `caregiver` reads `images.env` and creates every sandbox from it.
#
# Contract 06 §8's `build` is fixed argv with no interpolation, so it cannot
# carry the version a merge allocated. It does not need to: the script asks
# the registry for the digest of what it pushed, and the tree names the
# images by digest. The version is the stamp beside `images.env`.
manifest_version: "0.4"
name: playpen
repo: agent-control
path: playpen
kind: oci-image
unit: null
runs_as: sandbox
# `/usr/bin/env bash`, because §8 wants an absolute first word and the
# script's own first line names the same interpreter.
build:
  - ["/usr/bin/env", "bash", "playpen/bin/playpen-build"]
install:
  to: /opt/components/playpen
  prev: /opt/components/playpen.prev
provides:
  # Contract 03: start turn, events, stop, keep-alive, over one sbx exec.
  - { contract: channel, major: 0, minor: 12 }
requires:
  # Contract 04: the bridge turns the family's manifest into pi tools.
  - { contract: pep-grant, major: 0, min_minor: 11 }
depends_on: []
verify:
  # The hook ships in the tree `bin/playpen-build` stages (contract 06 §4
  # rule 6). It asks the registry for each digest `images.env` names. It
  # runs as the operator and changes nothing.
  command: ["/opt/components/playpen/bin/playpen-verify", "--json"]
  user: operator
  timeout_s: 180
restore:
  mode: automatic
  keep: 3
secrets: []
release: yes
